units.source_text: 于是，一天傍晚时分，杜子春又来到了洛阳西城门下，迷惘的看着天空，没地方可去。

en.t: So, one evening, Toshishun once again came beneath the western gate of Luoyang, gazing blankly up at the sky with nowhere to go.

units.source_text: 这个时候，就像上次那样，那位一只眼睛的老人家不知道什么时候出现了。

en.t: Just then, just as before, that one-eyed old man appeared, though no one knew when he had arrived.
